decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent upholstery fabric with established presentation and no clear negative signal, it remains a low-cost option worth retaining while sales potential continues to prove out.

After two seasons with only limited website prominence, this decorative fabric looks like a weaker option in a broad portfolio and is the most plausible candidate to prune in order to free resources for stronger lines and new development.
Its flame-retardant functionality matches the firm's contract-textile strengths, and the dedicated presentation suggests enough strategic value to continue holding the option open.
As the newest core-related fabric with its own page, it is still early in the learning period and should be kept until market feedback becomes more conclusive.
